high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "physicsgene." The post features a close-up photograph of a small piece of aerogel being held between two fingers. The aerogel appears translucent with a bluish tint and has a very low density, as indicated by its description. The text overlay on the image provides information about aerogel: Aerogel is also known as "frozen smoke." It is described as the world's lowest density solid, containing 96% air. A small piece can be held in one's hand without being felt or seen due to its transparency and light
